conclusions.established_about_saved_data: All 201 pinned eligible H2-marked rows agree with the absolute basic-block prediction and/or its induced quadratic-refinement formula within tolerance. The general-form SU(3)_2 controls include genuine off-diagonal witnesses and distinguish the correct Q^(-1) covector formula from the wrong direct-Q formula.
conclusions.figure21_scope: Figure 21 remains compatible at distribution level for 15 pointed MTC realizations after independently derived ordinary-aggregate presentation normalization, but contributes zero H2-marked pointwise checks of the quadratic formula.
conclusions.supported_but_not_proved: For modular input, the full twisted Yetter function appears to be the untwisted value multiplied by the quadratic phase induced from the invertible-object sector and the intersection form.

da4_standard_split_all_alpha.category_quadratic_function_observed: q_eval(a)=1 for all a in Z/3

figure21_exotic_target.why_not_all_alpha_verified: The saved Figure 21 computation records fixed-label distributions, not a certified H2 coordinate map from each alpha to the standard diagonal basis. Distribution equality cannot be promoted to the pointwise Pontryagin-square formula.

coordinate_map.formula: standard(h,e1,e2) = (B, A+B, C+2B) mod 3 for Yasui alpha=(C,A,B)

su3_general_intersection_forms.coordinate_convention: Stored character values are covector coordinates lambda. The homology coordinates are Q^(-1) lambda, so the scalar exponent is lambda^T Q^(-1) lambda mod 3.

explicit_non_claims: This artifact is not a proof of the modular quadratic formula.
This artifact does not turn the still-open 11/8 conjecture into a theorem.
This artifact does not use the tangent-bundle Pontryagin class p1(TM).
This artifact does not certify a Figure 21 H2 coordinate map.

candidate_modular_formula.coefficient_group: A=Aut_tensor(Id_C), identified with invertible objects when C is modular
candidate_modular_formula.dual_coordinate_formula_for_cyclic_examp: If stored coordinates are lambda=<alpha,basis>, first use a=Q^(-1)lambda. For q(a)=zeta^(c a^2), Phi=zeta^(c lambda^T Q^(-1) lambda).
candidate_modular_formula.normalization_safe_definition: q_C(a)=Z_C(CP2,a)/Z_C(CP2,0) in the pinned orientation convention

proof_obligations_not_discharged_by_data: Prove the twisted Kirby-color/simple-current identification with the exact orientation convention.
Prove the surface-defect evaluation and all normalization factors for arbitrary MTCs.
Prove basis independence and the torsion/Pontryagin-square extension in the claimed generality.
Keep the separate marked-stable no-go proof obligations under expert review.

reference_locators.role: classification by unimodular intersection form and Kirby-Siebenmann branch
11/8 statement, K3 equality, Donaldson definite case, and Rokhlin divisibility

simply_connected_topological_models.even_intersection_form: After orienting, write Q=-2kE8+nH. Rokhlin makes k integral. The still-open 11/8 conjecture is exactly n>=3k, which would give the unstabilized topological model #k K3 #(n-3k)(S2xS2).
simply_connected_topological_models.odd_intersection_form: Unconditionally, the unimodular odd form is diagonal in the indefinite case; Donaldson handles the smooth definite case. Freedman then identifies the topological model with connected sums of CP2 and -CP2, with the smooth Kirby-Siebenmann branch.
simply_connected_topological_models.scope: closed connected oriented smooth simply connected 4-manifolds
simply_connected_topological_models.stable_even_form_without_11_8: Even without 11/8, adding max(0,3k-n) hyperbolic summands makes the lattice a K3/S2xS2 block sum. Turning this algebra into an invariant identity still uses marked stable realization, connected-sum normalization, and nonzero stabilization.
simply_connected_topological_models.why_11_8_is_not_needed_for_an_existing_e: For a specified homeomorphic exotic pair, the shared intersection form is already known. Neither the pairwise no-go claim nor the direct quadratic formula needs 11/8.
simply_connected_topological_models.why_11_8_is_not_needed_for_direct_predic: Once the quadratic formula is proved, Q and alpha themselves already determine the phase. Named connected-sum blocks are a convenient presentation, not a logical prerequisite.

terminology_correction.reason: The proposed phase evaluates a finite-coefficient H2 background against the manifold intersection pairing. It is not a pairing of p1(TM) with that background.

top_notice: This artifact machine-checks a closed-form modular prediction against all pinned eligible H2-marked data. It does not prove the formula for arbitrary MTCs. Figure 21 remains only distribution-level evidence because no certified H2 marking exists.
